I wrote `src/index.ts`, and `npm run build` finished with no errors. The build also created `src/index.js` next to it; `.gitignore` already excludes `*.js`.

The contract is one function plus three types:

- **`scanLicences(versionLockfile, submissionLockfile)`** takes the two lockfiles as raw text. It returns a `ScanResult`, or throws if either text isn't JSON, has no `"packages"` object, or has a `lockfileVersion` other than 3. Every scenario in the spec can be tested through this one call.
- **`ScanResult`** is `{ passed: boolean; offenders: Offender[] }`. Offenders are listed once per name and version pair, ordered by name, then version.
- **`Offender`** is `{ name; version; licence: string | null; reason }`.
- **`OffenceReason`** is `"copyleft" | "unknown"`.

Two choices the spec doesn't fully settle:

- **No licence:** `licence` is `null` when an entry has none. I used `null` rather than leaving the field out, so both test suites can compare whole objects the same way.
- **Old-style licences:** for an old `license` object or `licenses` array, the spec doesn't say what "licence as written" should be. I left it unspecified rather than make up a rule. Tests that check that field in those cases may disagree with the implementation.

scanLicences, ScanResult, Offender, OffenceReason
